info.title: AlgoMinutes API
info.description: The AlgoMinutes API contract, generated from the zod schemas in @algominutes/contracts. Do not hand-edit the emitted JSON — edit the schemas and regenerate.

bearerAuth.description: Firebase Auth ID token. Absent only on the public routes: POST /v1/shares/read and POST /v1/client-error.

message.description: Free text. The server keeps the first 4000 characters.

ClientErrorReport.description: All fields optional; each string is length-capped server-side.

ClientVersion.name: X-AlgoMinutes-Client
ClientVersion.description: Client build identifier, "<platform>/<semver>" e.g. ios/1.4.0. The server refuses unsupported builds with 426.

get.summary: Readiness probe: proves the service can reach Postgres (post-deploy smoke).

post.summary: Full note + paginated transcript from Postgres.

200.description: Note read (first page) or transcript page.

404.description: Note not found (or caller is not a member).

post.summary: Persist a manual note edit (title + summary) to Postgres.
Name the diarised speakers of a note (per-note, ADR 0005).

400.description: Invalid note id / no valid speaker entries.

404.description: Note not found (or caller is not a member).

post.summary: Server-rendered DOCX export. Returns raw bytes on success.
Hybrid (vector + trigram) retrieval across a member’s notes.
Grounded chat over meetings. Streams Server-Sent Events.
post.description: Response is text/event-stream: an `event: citations` frame ({ hits }), then `data: { text }` frames, then `event: done` ({}). Failures emit `event: error` ({ error }).

200.description: SSE stream. See ChatCitationsEvent / ChatTextEvent / ChatErrorEvent for frame payloads.

post.summary: Mint a public read link. The raw token is returned here and nowhere else.
Revoke a link (idempotent).
PUBLIC read of a shared note. No bearer token — the link token is the credential.
Delete the caller’s account and all owned data (App Store + GDPR).

405.description: Method not allowed (POST or DELETE only).

delete.summary: Delete the caller’s account and all owned data (App Store + GDPR).

405.description: Method not allowed (POST or DELETE only).

post.summary: Queue a recording or import for processing (async kickoff). Idempotent for a note already in flight.

202.description: Already being processed: nothing was changed or charged.

400.description: Missing or invalid fields, storagePath, or sourceUrl.

403.description: Workspace mismatch, or not your note.

429.description: Hourly processing or upload limit reached.

post.summary: Rate a note’s transcription or summary (1–5), optionally with a comment. Upserts per (note, user, kind).

400.description: Invalid fields, rating, kind or comment.

post.summary: Regenerate a note’s summary, optionally with another template. Manual edits need confirmOverwrite.

409.description: Manual edits present (confirm to overwrite), or already regenerating.

503.description: Unavailable until Postgres is provisioned, or being upgraded.

post.summary: Start a resumable upload. The client PUTs chunks straight to `sessionUri` (GCS).

get.summary: How many bytes GCS has received for the caller’s upload.

404.description: Unknown, someone else’s, or expired upload.

post.summary: Confirm the upload finished (the object exists in storage).

404.description: Unknown, someone else’s, or expired upload.

get.summary: Server-resolved plan, reverse-trial state and metered usage. The only source of truth for quota.

post.summary: Record a conversion-funnel event (best-effort; a storage failure still answers 202).
Register (upsert) this device’s push token.
Set how long notes are kept (days), or null to keep until deleted.
Record a timestamped, versioned Terms + Privacy acceptance.
Contact support or report a bad transcript/summary (diagnostic context only, never content).
PUBLIC crash beacon. No auth and no client-version gate, so a crashing client can always report.

get.summary: Operator view of dead-lettered tasks (ADMIN_UIDS only), newest first.

post.summary: Mark a dead letter resolved (idempotent).
